name: group_rows_simple_row_ends_at_unrelated_question

fields.label: How did you learn about this job opportunity?

spec_quote: A row ends at the next School-type box (which starts a new row) or at the first box whose label is not an education-row label (e.g. "How did you learn about this job opportunity?", "First Name", "Email").

name: group_rows_lone_school_box_not_a_row
spec_quote: A row only counts when it contains a Degree or a Major box (labels "Degree", "Degree Type", "Major", "Field of Study" …); a lone School box is not a row.

name: group_rows_label_star_and_colon_normalized
spec_quote: A row starts at a box labelled "School", "College", "University", "Institution", "School Name" or "Name of School" (a leading "*" and a trailing ":" in labels are ignored).

name: group_rows_non_education_label_ends_row

fields.label: Please describe any relevant certifications or coursework you have completed

spec_quote: A row ends at the next School-type box (which starts a new row) or at the first box whose label is not an education-row label.

name: row_plan_three_rows_one_extra_empty_no_selection
spec_quote: Empty rows, in page order, take the entries (profile order A, B) that have no row yet; empty rows left over are deleted.

name: row_plan_later_duplicate_entry_row_deleted
spec_quote: The first row of an entry holds it; a later row of the same entry is deleted.

name: row_plan_empty_rows_fill_missing_entries
spec_quote: Empty rows, in page order, take the entries (profile order A, B) that have no row yet; empty rows left over are deleted.

name: row_plan_unmatched_and_missing_entry_added
spec_quote: A non-empty row that belongs to no entry is "unmatched" (a person decides). Entries that still have no row are to be added.

name: row_plan_other_companion_name_and_empty_other
spec_quote: A row's school text is its School value; when the School value starts with "Other", the companion value is the school text instead. A row is EMPTY when that text is empty or a placeholder (also "Other" with an empty companion).

name: pick_school_normalized_match
spec_quote: So "The University of Chicago", "University of Chicago (IL)" and "UNIVERSITY OF CHICAGO" are Entry A.

name: pick_school_missing_prefers_exact_other
spec_quote: else [option, "other"] for an "Other" option — exactly "Other" first, then an option starting with "Other" (e.g. "Other - Not Listed").

name: pick_school_only_placeholder_no_match
spec_quote: Placeholders are never real options or values: "No Selection", "Select", "Select One", "Please select", "-", "---", "There were no results", "No results", "No results found", "No matches", "Loading…".

name: pick_school_near_miss_not_match
spec_quote: A name that merely contains the school ("Loyola University Chicago", "University of Illinois Chicago", "University of Chicago Laboratory Schools") is NOT that school in the list pick (rule 3).

name: pick_degree_master_fallback_starting_master
spec_quote: else for a master entry the first option starting with "Master" (e.g. "Masters", "Master's Degree"), then one containing "Master", then one starting with "Graduate".

name: pick_degree_bachelor_exact_full_degree
spec_quote: pick_degree(options, entry) → the option equal (case-insensitive) to the entry's full degree name.

name: pick_major_exact
spec_quote: pick_major(options, major) → the option equal to the major (case-insensitive).

name: pick_major_multi_word_subset_not_one_word
spec_quote: else the first option of two or more words whose words all appear in the major ("Data Science" for "Applied Data Science")... A one-word option such as "Science" or "Data" never counts as the major.

name: pick_major_fallback_information_systems
spec_quote: else "Computer Science"; else "Information Systems" (also "Information System", "Computer Information Systems", "Management Information Systems").

name: companion_prefers_text_specify_over_combo_and_gpa
spec_quote: companion(row boxes) → the key of the text / textarea box in the row whose label says "other", "not listed", "specify", "school name" or "institution name" (never a combo, never the GPA box).

name: companion_fallback_notes_when_other_only_combo
spec_quote: if none, the row's box labelled "Comments" / "Comment" / "Notes" / "Additional Information"; else null.

name: pick_status_current_skips_not_currently_attending
spec_quote: for a current entry the first option starting with "Attending", "Currently Attending", "Enrolled", "In Progress", "Pursuing" or "Current" that does not contain "no longer" or "not".

name: pick_status_ended_graduated
spec_quote: for an entry that ended on or before today the first option starting with "Graduated", "Completed", "Degree Awarded" or "Degree Received".

name: rebind_three_school_boxes_exactly_one_untaken
spec_quote: a read-back row {key, label} moves to another field only when its own key is no longer among the fields AND exactly one field with the same label exists whose key is not in `taken` (keys held by other rows); then that field's key; otherwise null (keep the key). Three boxes labelled "School" must never be collapsed into the first one.

name: rebind_three_school_boxes_all_untaken_keep_key
spec_quote: otherwise null (keep the key). Three boxes labelled "School" must never be collapsed into the first one.
